description: List the products that are on one marketplace, with each listing external id, what the marketplace last reported about it (`presence`, valid only when `observedAt` is set — null `observedAt` means the marketplace has never been asked about that listing, not that it is absent; Prom is reconciled every 15 minutes, other channels only when a sync or publish runs), whether the workspace paused syncing it, its price and stock. Also returns the honest totals over the whole channel and the ACTIVE products that have no listing there at all (the 'did not match by SKU' list), which is usually the answer when a push updated fewer products than expected. Use check_channel_readiness for why a product would be refused.

platform.description: The marketplace slug returned by list_marketplaces (prom, rozetka, olx, amazon, ebay, shopify, woocommerce).

name: list_channel_products
title: List channel products
